script_text: Cancer, the cosmic tides are shifting dramatically as your ruling Moon opposes Pluto in your 7th House of partnerships this week. Early on, Monday through Wednesday, Venus sextiles Uranus in your 11th House, sparking an unexpected but lucrative career opportunity or sudden social breakthrough. However, Wednesday brings tension as Mars squares Saturn in your 10th House, potentially causing friction with an authority figure or a delay in a professional project. The mid-week turning point arrives Thursday when the Sun trines intense Pluto, empowering you to transform a key relationship dynamic and take control of your shared resources. Heading into the weekend, Venus enters your romantic 5th House on Friday, promising a delightful surge in your love life and creative passions. Sunday is best for relaxation as Mercury enters Taurus in your 11th House. Tuesday is your power day because the Venus-Uranus sextile opens financial doors. Thursday is your most challenging day because Mars squares Saturn in your career sector. Trust your intuition this week, as your Water element guides you through these changing currents. Follow for daily updates.
